+1

For a 50-person Indian company, I’d compare the strongest practical models this way. Public providers generally do not publish a single all-in annual price, so the meaningful number is the negotiated transaction/service fee plus actual travel spend.

Option	Cost structure	Cancellation / refunds	Support & “warranty”	Best suited to
Trip.Biz / Trip.com	Custom corporate quote; consumer Trip.com fares are booking-specific	Airline/fare rules govern refunds; Trip.com provides 24/7 support and booking/price guarantees with stated exclusions. 
Trip.com
+1
	24/7 multilingual support; OBT, approvals, reporting and payment tools. 
Trip.com
+1
	Tech-first teams with substantial international travel
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Negotiated service fee plus fare; payment gateway can add 1.5%. 
MakeMyTrip
	Corporate fares can include reduced cancellation fees, but fare rules still matter. 
MakeMyTrip Business
	24/7 dedicated support. 
MakeMyTrip Business
	India-heavy travel and GST-conscious companies
FCM Travel India	Custom TMC/transaction quote	Cancellation can reach 100% of booking cost; supplier/refund and reissue charges can also apply. 
FCM Travel
	Dedicated consultant + 24/7 emergency assistance; negotiated hotel/air content. 
FCM Travel
+1
	Companies wanting full-service managed travel
Amex BTA + TMC	Custom TMC fees + travel spend; BTA consolidates air expenditure	Supplier rules govern; Amex terms warn some fares may be non-refundable. 
American Express
	Central billing, reconciliation, insurance up to ₹30 lakh, 24/7 Global Assist; payment period up to 51 days. 
American Express
	Finance-led travel control
What to demand in the quote

Ask each provider for a 12-month TCO showing: booking fee, reissue/cancellation fee, hotel markup, implementation, GST, payment fees, after-hours support, unused-ticket credits, refund turnaround, SLA/response times, and contract termination fees.

Important: “warranty” in travel usually means service/booking guarantees, not a warranty on the underlying airfare. The airline’s fare rules remain decisive. 
Trip.com
+1
